description: SIMULATED: the ball thrown to the model's alternative receiver. This did not happen. Real play: (5:42) (No Huddle, Shotgun) M.Stafford pass short left to Al.Robinson to BUF 28 for 12 yards (T.Edmunds).

coordinates.note: SIMULATED. This play did not happen. The positions were generated by the play model as a counterfactual alternative and are not an observation of anything — label every frame drawn from them.
coordinates.units: yards; x downfield 0-120 with the offense attacking +x, y across 0-53.3

orientation.note: o is body orientation, dir is direction of travel; they are different and must not be derived from each other. o_source on every row says how that value was arrived at.

gaze.note: Where a player was LOOKING is not measured by anything, in this or any public football dataset. No such column exists here. The closest available signal is interactions.ball_in_view, which is inferred from body orientation and marked as inferred on every record.

assumptions: Value is expected points added, estimated from similar throws in the 2022 season, weeks 1-9.
Receivers are compared at the instant of the throw; nothing later in the play is used.
The play call and the quarterback's progression are unknown; an open receiver may not have been a read.
An alternative is only considered if receivers in his position do get thrown to.
Scored by models fitted on other games, so the outcome of this play was never seen.
Throws more than 5 seconds after the snap are never flagged: by then the play has broken down and the throw may be a throwaway.
Win probability is converted from expected points using the league's own win probability for this game state.
